page_title: RMA 2-0 PAL | Real Madrid v Las Palmas 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Enzo Loiodice plays a pass to Marvin (Las Palmas), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the right post.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
88' Kirian (Las Palmas) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Rodrygo (Real Madrid) heads on.
86' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
84' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
83' Marvin (Las Palmas) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
79' What was Saul Coco (Las Palmas) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
78' Kirian (Las Palmas) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
77' Javier Munoz will be replaced by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jonathan Viera as he is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
77' It is time for a substitution. Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is on for Eduardo Camavinga.
77' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Ferland Mendy is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
76' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
74' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Kirian (Las Palmas). It wasn't such a big threat for him.

73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.

73' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
70' Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
69' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
66' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Here comes a substitution. Marvin (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Sory Kaba.
57' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Joselu and he is replaced by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daniel Ceballos (Real Madrid) for Brahim Diaz.
54' 2 - 0 Joselu (Real Madrid) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
53' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
52' The game is interrupted as Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) is flagged offside.
49' The attendance for today's match is 65017.
46' Half-time substitution. Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas) will not participate anymore and Kirian is coming on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) comes off for Sergi Cardona.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' 1 - 0 Goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) takes a short pass from Lucas Vazquez in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the top left corner. 1:0.
45+2' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

45+2' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A corner kick by Real Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
45' Joselu (Real Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
44' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

44' Alvaro Valles was forced into action to thwart Joselu (Real Madrid). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
43' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
41' David Alaba is substituted due to injury. Carlo Ancelotti gives a chance to Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
39' The game is interrupted now, David Alaba (Real Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
33' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Alvaro Valles is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
33' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

32' He should have scored! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid), who has already been caught several times today.
25' Lovely run from Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
23' Real Madrid fail to score from a corner as Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) leaps to collect the ball.
22' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

21' He should have scored! Joselu (Real Madrid) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Alvaro Valles makes an easy save. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
20' The linesman raises his flag. Joselu (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
19' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
18' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
15' Joselu (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
10' Flag up against Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
5' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.

The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero will officiate today.
